rows.text: calls `00310D30` + 0x15 with the incoming registers and returns when it yields null; otherwise, on that returned pointer, calls + 0x33 with the three floats at `rcx+0x0`, `rcx+0x4` and `rcx+0x8` in `xmm1`, `xmm2` and `xmm3`, then calls + 0x3E and + 0x49 each with the incoming float `xmm1`

notes: 00310D30: all four callees are cited by site because the host excerpt names none of them. The pointer returned by + 0x15 is passed as rcx to all three later calls; rcx+0x0..+0x8 refers to the incoming rcx (kept in rdi).
